verdict.rationale: The evidence shows monday.com has a GraphQL API, an llms.txt documentation index, and a published OpenAPI spec. None of it documents an interactive API reference, an API playground, or runnable examples. A machine-readable spec and plain API docs are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
